Digital Content Producer Job at BBC Hausa




        
    

        
        The BBC is an international multimedia broadcaster on radio, TV, online and social networks with a weekly global audience of 320 million. As part of an historic multi-million pound expansion of BBC Africa, the BBC World Service is introducing a wide range of new and exciting language and regional content to serve African and global audiences.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Digital Content Producer, BBC Hausa 

Job Requisition ID: 50555
Job Location: Abuja

Why join the team
     

            
    




	This video producer/journalist role is central to that transformation.
	The successful candidate will help build BBC Hausa’s video and visual storytelling capability, contributing to filming, editing, scripting, presenting, and end-to-end content production.


Your Key Responsibilities and Impact


	Proven experience creating and delivering high impact digital journalism, with a strong understanding of audience engagement, growth and content performance across multiple platforms.
	Excellent news judgement, with the ability to identify compelling angles, simplify complex stories and shape content for digital and mobile first audiences.
	Strong multimedia production skills, including scripting, producing and editing video, audio and social content from concept through to publication.
	Deep understanding of Hausa speaking audiences, with the ability to create culturally relevant and engaging content for audiences across the region and diaspora.
	Experience using audience insights, analytics and emerging technologies, including AI supported workflows, to optimise content while maintaining strong editorial standards.
	Outstanding writing, editing and communication skills in Hausa and English, with meticulous attention to accuracy, impartiality and editorial integrity.
	A collaborative and adaptable team player who thrives in fast paced news environments, manages competing priorities effectively and builds positive working relationships across teams and stakeholders.


Your Skills and Experience
Essential Criteria:


	Proven experience creating high performing content across social platforms including YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, X and TikTok, with a strong understanding of audience engagement and growth strategies.
	Strong video production and editing skills, with experience creating compelling short, mid and long form content using tools such as Final Cut Pro and QEdit.
	Ability to use audience analytics and performance data to optimise content, refine editorial approaches and maximise reach and impact.
	Excellent storytelling, scripting and presentation skills, with the ability to create engaging digital video and visualised audio content for younger audiences.
	Deep understanding of youth audiences and digital consumption habits, adapting formats, tone and storytelling techniques to maximise relevance and engagement.
	Experience using AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance research, content creation, editing and production workflows while maintaining high editorial standards.
	Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams while combining sound editorial judgement with excellent digital production expertise.

title: Customer Service Executive Job at Recruitment Nigeria (NG) Limited
content:
Recruitment Nigeria (NG) Limited is a dedicated consultingfirm specializing in connecting top talent with leading companies across various industries. Established with a mission to simplify the hiring process, the company provides tailored recruitment solutions that meet the unique needs of its clients. Recruitment NG Limited's expert team is committed to delivering exceptional service, ensuring that both employers and job seekers find the perfect match for their requirements. The firm believes in fostering long-term relationships and contributing to the growth and success of businesses and individuals alike. 
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Service Executive
Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Customer Service Supervisor / Operations Manager

Job Summary


	The Customer Service Representative is responsible for providing excellent customer service by responding to enquiries, resolving complaints, processing customer requests, and ensuring a positive customer experience.
	The role requires strong communication skills, professionalism and the ability to build and maintain good customer relationships while promoting the company's products and services.


Key Responsibilities


	Respond to customer enquiries through telephone calls, emails, social media, WhatsApp and other communication channels.
	Handle customer complaints professionally and ensure timely resolution or escalation where necessary.
	Provide accurate information about the company's products, services and processes.
	Process customer requests, applications and service related documentation.
	Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and update customer information in the company's database.
	Follow up on customer requests and complaints to ensure satisfactory resolution.
	Build and maintain positive relationships with customers by delivering quality service.
	Work closely with internal departments to resolve customer issues promptly.
	Receive and document customer feedback and recommend areas for service improvement.
	Ensure compliance with the company's customer service policies and procedures.
	Prepare periodic reports on customer enquiries and complaints when required.
	Maintain confidentiality of customer and company information.
	Perform any other duties assigned by Management.


Qualifications


	Possess a Bachelor's Degree or Higher National Diploma (HND) in Business Administration, Mass Communication, Marketing, Public Administration or any related discipline with 2 – 4 years relevant experience in Customer Service, Customer Support or a similar role.


Skills and Competencies:


	Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
	Strong interpersonal and customer relationship management skills.
	Good problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.
	Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple tasks.
	Good organizational and time management skills.
	High level of professionalism and integrity.
	Strong attention to detail.
	Ability to work independently and within a team.


Technical Skills:


	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint).
	Experience using CRM or customer management software is an added advantage.
	Good computer literacy and data entry skills.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Application Letter and CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.    

    

        Click here to Apply
